newsitem.title: USA: Tracor to combine Vitro and Applied subs.
newsitem.headline: Tracor to combine Vitro and Applied subs.

text.p: Tracor Inc said Thursday it is combining its subsidiaries Vitro Corp and Tracor Applied Sciences Inc to form one business unit, Tracor Systems Engineering.

"The result will be increased focus on Tracor's core customers in the U.S. Department of Defense and other federal agencies," said Tracor's president James Skagg in a statement. He added the realignment will "also allow additional streamlining of operations."

A company spokeswoman said the subsidiaries "were so similar it just made sense to combine them." She said the company expected cost savings from the restructuring but hadn't put a dollar amount on it yet. Few people have been cut, she added.

The new unit, which provides systems engineering and technical services, will be headed by Barry Campbell, formerly president of Vitro, as chairman and chief executive officer and Bruce Hamilton, formerly president of Applied Sciences, as president and chief operating officer.
Tracor's stock traded at 25-5/8 Thursday morning, down 1/8.
